decision.reason: [ev-0483f04624d3] only covers the unaffected case: environments that never configured -boltdb.shipper.shared-store, -tsdb.shipper.shared-store or the matching YAML need no changes. Its section heading says `shared_store` was removed from the shipper configuration. Neither says what happens to environments that did set these values. They could be silently ignored, rejected at startup, or need a migration step, so setting-ignored and its high severity are not supported. To decide, we need the rest of that upgrade-guide section, which describes the configured case.
